notes: Dataset upload on mobile: the drop zone is a plain container with a transparent full-size <input type=file> overlay, plus a click fallback that opens the native picker exactly once — tapping the zone, the icon, the copy or the 'Tap to choose files' pill all open the phone's file manager (frontend/js/datasets.js, frontend/css/components.css).
Android file input now clears the previous value before the chooser opens (not during change), and selection events stop bubbling into unrelated page handlers.
The last route is held in session storage so returning from Android's system file chooser does not unexpectedly reset the SPA to Dashboard.
Training chart empty states are absolutely contained inside their fixed-height chart box, preventing the dashed placeholder from covering the Training log.
Backend checkpoint reads/writes use the owning model because the live checkpoints table has no owner_id column; production web origin is included in the backend CORS allowlist.

Fluid scaling for every aspect ratio: root font-size steps at 1440/1920/2560px, --page-max grows to 1680px/2080px, extra grid columns instead of stretched cards, ultra-wide (21:9, 32:9) keeps a measured reading column, portrait tablets keep a narrow column, TV/remote focus rings are 3px, and print hides chrome (frontend/css/responsive.css).
Local CSS/JS are requested with ?v=<buildId> so a cached stylesheet can never hide a shipped fix again (frontend/index.html).
howToVerify: GET <frontend-url>/version.json — the deployed buildId must equal the buildId committed in frontend/version.json on main.
